name: Necromancer Lich Commander makes Command spells cost 5 less Runic Power (#725)
contract: Lich Commander 704713 is a Class-tab node (CharacterAdvancement 5781, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 87, AbilityEssenceCost 1, choice group with Corpse Commander 707739) whose description reads 'Reduces the Runic Power cost of your Command spells by $/10;s1.' Its effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50 (Runic Power is stored x10, so 5 Runic Power), EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x1000000) in SpellFamilyName 29: the Command family flag that AscensionNecromancer::Command also tests. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies the caster's SPELLMOD_COST, so Command: Skeletal Mage 504020 (PowerType 6, ManaCost 400) must cost 350 and Command: Ghouls 504021 (ManaCost 300) 250, while Corpse Explosion 533236 (ManaCost 400, family flags 0, 0x100, 0) is not a Command and stays at 400. A real Command: Skeletal Mage cast must spend 400 Runic Power before the talent and 350 after it; the fixture's ordinary regeneration and decay are suppressed so the spend is exact.
